5256-7084-8338.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

3812-6723-7008.easyPrerequisites: Simic Ragworm doesn't have summoning sickness.
3812-6723-7008.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-5702-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-5702-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1257-3861-7857.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7828-7834.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7828-7834.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

341-2781-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

461-2468-7789.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Zevlor by paying {2} and tapping it.
Resolve the Panoptic Mirror trigger, casting a copy of Worst Fears without paying its mana cost, targeting an opponent.
Zevlor triggers, copying Worst Fears targeting each other opponent.
Resolve each Worst Fears, causing you to control each opponent during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

3525-5268-7734.description:
Activate Wakandan Tusker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

4997-7176-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4997-7176-7414.description:
Activate Oko, Lorwyn Liege's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Pensive Professor to gain all creature types.
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

560-2034-2919-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-2034-2919-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

5660-5684-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {0}.
Marketback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

1978-2593-3088.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2511-3239-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-3490-4659-6794.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
3097-3490-4659-6794.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

38-2018-4053.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2035-4067-6351.easyPrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
You control an additional creature.
2035-4067-6351.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gollum, untapping the permanent.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, returning Gollum from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1020-1117-2510-6518.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1020-1117-2510-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2653-2783-2972-6455.description:
Cast Encroaching Dragonstorm by paying {3}{G}.
When Encroaching Dragonstorm enters, it first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped
When the lands enter the battlefield, Nissa and Nesting Dragon trigger twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve a Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Ganax and Encroaching Dragonstorm's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Encroaching Dragonstorm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat

654-1170-2499-2733-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating three 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers three times, causing you to get six {E}.
Repeat.

396-2034-3000-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorn and Squirrel, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1805-3525-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Pyramid of the Pantheon does not have summoning sickness.
Pyramid of the Pantheon has at least three brick counters.
1805-3525-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Pyramid of the Pantheon to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat from step 2.
